app_identity.name: Delhi Crime Detection & Safety Intelligence
app_identity.vibe: High-authority, urban intelligence interface with clear experimental-data context for Delhi NCT.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

colors.rules: Never use pure #000000; use deep navy-tinted black (#0A0D14). Text contrast must strictly satisfy WCAG AA.

layout_and_pages.navigation: Sticky top bar with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-#0A0D14/80 border-b border-white/10 z-50). Displays brand badge, live status ticker, and primary navigation tabs.

pages.name: Home / Landing Page
pages.features: Hero banner with Delhi project summary, project abstract, college/academic banner (Department of CS/IT), key features grid, and team member showcase.

pages.name: Live Safety Map & Tracking
pages.features: Split-screen layout with interactive Leaflet map, simulated live subject movement, real-time crime risk heatmap overlay, radius risk indicator, and quick alert trigger.

pages.name: Crime Analytics Dashboard
pages.features: Interactive charts analyzing the synthetic Delhi dataset (crime types, hour-of-day distribution, day-of-week trends, and zone risk rankings) using Recharts.

pages.name: Emergency Speed Dial
pages.features: Tactical speed dial grid with single-click call trigger for Police (100/112), Women Helpline (1090), Ambulance (108), Cyber Crime (1930), and Senior Citizen Helpline.

pages.name: Police Stations Directory
pages.features: Delhi NCT police stations directory, distance calculation from the selected location, Superintendent/SHO in-charge details, and direct map focus.

pages.name: Methodology & Research
pages.features: Academic breakdown of K-Means Spatial Clustering, dataset schema analysis, tech stack specification, and project references.

component_design_guidelines.speed_dial: High-visibility tactical cards with pulse animation, distinct color codes per service (Red for Police/Fire, Pink/Purple for Women Safety, Cyan for Cyber, Green for Medical), and prominent phone action buttons.
component_design_guidelines.police_cards: Compact cardless or crisp-bordered tiles with SP/SHO name badge, contact number, distance indicator badge (e.g., '1.8 km away'), and interactive 'View on Map' button.
component_design_guidelines.charts: Recharts with dark slate tooltips, glow filters on line graphs, custom amber/red gradient bars for high-crime hours, and crisp legends.
component_design_guidelines.map_controls: Floating tactical widget panel on map with layer toggles (Heatmap, Subject Marker, Nearest Stations, Risk Clusters) and simulated GPS movement toggle.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.data_test_id: All interactive buttons, links, search inputs, tabs, map controls, and speed-dial cards MUST include a descriptive `data-testid` attribute (e.g. data-testid="nav-live-map-button", data-testid="speed-dial-police-100").
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react icons exclusively. Avoid AI emojis as primary icons.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.toasts: Use sonner for notifications (e.g., when triggering emergency alert or copying helpline number).
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.responsive: Ensure seamless mobile and desktop navigation. Mobile navigation should feature a crisp sheet/drawer or bottom action bar.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.academic_touch: Include subtle academic metadata such as 'Delhi NCT Crime Study', 'Experimental Spatial Clustering Model', and 'Department of Computer Science & Engineering'.
